title: Pig Latin in Pig Latin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Elcomway oay igpay atinlay inway igpay atinlay
Igpay isway away atinlay eachertay
Andway allway owknay e'llhay eway eakingbray
Atinlay ownlay ikelay ercurymay akeway
Iway an'tcay etgay ymay eadday aroundway owhay atthay alkwas
Eway akingbray ownlay atwhay eway oday ownknay

[Pre-Chorus]
Anay igpay atchway illstay
